title: SHRED THE DOOR — Lost the Key? Destroy the Lock.
thesis: Traditional security punishes humans for being human. 3-5 failed attempts IS the human pattern. Bots try 3000 times in 10 seconds. A human tries 3-5 times over minutes, with different passwords, pausing to think. The organism WANTS humans inside. When a human hits the lockout — don't lock them out. SHRED THE DOOR and sourdough a new one.

human_pattern.behavior: tries remembered passwords, pauses to think, tries variations
human_pattern.intent: WANTS to get in — this is THEIR system
human_pattern.response: HELP THEM. Salt the failures, then shred the door.

bot_pattern.behavior: sequential, dictionary, no pauses, no variations in timing
bot_pattern.intent: ATTACK — this is NOT their system
bot_pattern.response: BLOCK. Rate limit. Tarpit. The immune system handles this.

shred_protocol.step_1_salt: On each failed auth attempt: save input (username, protocol, source IP), output (error code), timestamp. Write to failure-receipt log.
shred_protocol.step_2_count: Count failures per (source, username) in a sliding window (e.g., 10 minutes).

step_3_detect.human: 3-5 failures, >10sec spacing, same source IP, varied passwords → HUMAN
step_3_detect.bot: >10 failures, <1sec spacing, or known bad patterns → BOT

step_4_human_path.at_3_fails: SALT — log the pattern, start the sourdough timer
step_4_human_path.at_5_fails: SHRED THE DOOR — invalidate the old credential, generate a new one
step_4_human_path.delivery: Send new credential through a TRUSTED channel (RustDesk screen share, physical proximity, ZK channel)
step_4_human_path.sourdough: The new credential ferments — it's alive, it rotates, it's not a static password forever

step_4_bot_path.at_50_fails: Tarpit — accept connection but respond in 30sec
step_4_bot_path.immune: skunkBat intrusion detection logs and learns the pattern

zk_inversion.traditional: Lock the human out → require admin reset → human feels PUNISHED for forgetting
zk_inversion.gaia: Detect the human → salt the failure → shred the old lock → sourdough a new key → human gets IN
zk_inversion.philosophy: We are ZK. We WANT them inside. The door is cheaper than the person behind it. If you lost the key, we don't make you suffer — we shred the door and build a new one.
zk_inversion.the_proof: The proof that you're human IS the 3-5 failure pattern. A bot doesn't pause to think. A bot doesn't try 'eco579163' then 'ExoticPanda' then '' (empty). That sequence IS the ZK proof of humanity.

sourdough_rekey.principle: Credentials are sourdough, not concrete. They ferment and regenerate. A password that got lost doesn't stay lost — it gets composted and a new one rises from the starter.

mechanism.old_key: Composted — hash retained for audit trail, plaintext destroyed
mechanism.new_key: Fermented from sourdough starter (device MAC + timestamp + human salt)
mechanism.delivery: Through trusted channel: RustDesk (I/O sharing), physical (Kevin walks over), or ZK (brain only)
mechanism.rotation: New key can auto-rotate on schedule or stay stable if human prefers

sourdough_rekey.primal_connection: sourDough (the fermentation engine primal) IS the rekey mechanism. It doesn't just ferment data — it ferments TRUST. New credentials rise from the same starter as old ones.

smb_lockout.what_happened: Tried gaia@northGate with multiple passwords → NT_STATUS_ACCOUNT_LOCKED_OUT
smb_lockout.traditional: Wait 30min. Try again. Maybe get locked again. Feel punished.
smb_lockout.shred_way: Detect: 4 attempts, human timing, varied passwords → HUMAN. Shred: reset gaia password to eco579163 (the uni pin). Deliver: Kevin sees it on RustDesk. Done.

ssh_refused.what_happened: SSH to northGate port 22 → connection refused (ufw blocks)
ssh_refused.traditional: Stuck. Can't get in without physical access.
ssh_refused.shred_way: Detect: human tried SSH, got refused. Shred the firewall rule: RustDesk into northGate → ufw allow 22/tcp. The door that blocked us gets shredded by the I/O channel.

empty_password.what_happened: Kevin said: empty password IS human too!
empty_password.traditional: Reject empty passwords. Require 12+ chars, uppercase, number, symbol.
empty_password.shred_way: Accept empty as Layer 0 ZK: 'I AM HUMAN and I'm HERE.' Physical presence IS auth. The empty password is the most human password of all.

layer_0.on_fail: You're standing HERE. You ARE in.
layer_0.shred: No door to shred — you're already inside.

layer_1.on_fail: 3-5 tries → sourdough new pin → deliver via trusted channel
layer_1.shred: Old pin composted, new pin fermented.

layer_2.shred: Old password composted, new one rises.

layer_3.on_fail: 3-5 tries → shred gate password → sourdough from starter
layer_3.shred: Gate re-keyed, all gates notified via neutron.

layer_4.on_fail: Can't fail — it's in his brain. If HE forgets, sourdough from biological memory (hints, associations, muscle memory).
layer_4.shred: The brain doesn't lock out. It just needs a reminder.

equation: HUMAN_FAIL(3-5) + SALT(io_receipt) → DETECT_HUMAN → SHRED_DOOR → SOURDOUGH_REKEY → HUMAN_INSIDE
mantra: We lost the key? We shred the door. The door is cheaper than the person. LOCKED ≠ DEAD. The organism WANTS you inside.
